vetSays.line: A person, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm: "Nothing grows here but dirt and tents. Past the treeline — that's where the green is. That's where the food is."
A person, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm heads out for water. "Off to the well — back with a full skin." Company makes the road shorter.
💧 A person, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm returns with water: +3 clean.

"Hey." A person, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm settles near you, not too close. "Day one. Everyone's pretending they're fine. ...Can we talk? Just talk — like people used to." (Talk to A person, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm.)
A person, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm is staring into the fire like it owes them answers.
A person, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm hesitates, then backs off. "Not today. Sorry." (Low trust — reluctant.)
A person, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm hesitates, then backs off. "Not today. Sorry." (Low trust — reluctant.)
A person, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm heads out for water. "Off to the well — back with a full skin." The pantry won't fill itself.
You catch fragments by the fire — A woman, maybe 60s, with a farmer's tan telling A person, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm about you. It's picking up decorations as it travels.
💧 A person, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm returns with water: +2 clean.
"You haven't earned that yet," A person, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm says. (Trust too low.)
You give A person, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm 3 portions of Dried beans, with the village watching. They look at you differently now.
A person, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm heads out for water. "Fetching water. Somebody has to." The pantry won't fill itself.
💧 A person, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm returns with water: +4 clean.
"Can we talk?" A person, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm sits down near you. "Just... talk. Like people used to." (Talk to A person, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm.)
👂 Overheard — A person, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm: "Yeah. Yeah, okay. That's solid."
A person, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm heads out for water. "Off to the well — back with a full skin." The pantry won't fill itself.
...and then it lands: A person, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm speaks 🇸🇦 Arabic. You share no language at all.
🛡️ Nora, Francisco, Dany, Daniyar and Elijah met them at the door — 4 put down, 1 driven off. Nora, Francisco, Dany, Daniyar, Elijah are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Maya just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Maya just put down The Redactor... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Dany just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Chantal just put down The Terms of Service... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
🛡️ Patricia, Francisco, Dany, Daniyar and Chantal met them at the door — 4 put down, 1 barely walked away. Patricia, Francisco, Dany, Daniyar, Chantal are hurt.

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Daniyar just put down Ugly-Bane... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "You've gotten too big for the story. Ratings are GREAT, by the way — but you're threatening the narrative now. So the narrative is fighting back. Meet the PRODUCERS."
⚠ This one is different — scarred, braced, waiting for your opening. A Scarred veteran.
It saw the opening coming — braced, scar tissue white. Your first strike glances off. (SCARRED: -3 first strike)
The Scarred Chorus Line falls.
📺 +20 style — dropped the Scarred Chorus Line!
